description: Defines the class TemplateMultiEnum, a PHP class extending TemplateEnum, for handling multi-select enum fields in SuiteCRM, including methods for rendering HTML, preparing data, and saving configurations.

classes.name: TemplateMultiEnum
classes.description: A PHP class for multi-select enum field handling in SuiteCRM, providing methods for rendering, data processing, and configuration management.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Returns HTML for editing the multi-select enum field.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Prepares and returns template variables for editing the field.

methods.name: get_xtpl_list
methods.description: Returns detailed template variables for list view.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Returns template variables for detailed view of the field.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array, including multi-select configuration.

methods.name: get_db_default
methods.description: Returns default database value for the field.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the field configuration, encoding default and dependency data.
